items.h: Core sector growth eases to 5.4% in July from 6% in June; iron ore, cement drive expansion
items.p: India's core infrastructure sectors grew 5.4% in July, easing from June's revised 6%, as iron ore, cement and electricity remained the main drivers.

items.h: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
items.p: India anticipates a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in FY27, but experts warn that this may not strengthen the rupee. The impact hinges on whether the inflows from the RBI’s FCNR deposits actually enter the market or are absorbed as reserves.
